design: Long-limbed lithe female adult Yautja rooftop watch guard with green-grey banded hide, exposed narrow skull and elegant but alien curved four mandibles. Dreadlocks in two rear bundles secured by plain bronze rings. Close fitting black scale vest with high collar, slim dark shin plates, short layered mail skirt, one bare muscular arm and one segmented vambrace. A small folded crossbow-like alien launcher is holstered at the thigh; hands loosely clasped in front of belt. Upright alert silhouette.
